title: NFTMigrator lacks reentrancy guard
description: `migrate()` mints V2 NFTs via `v2.mintFor`, which invokes `_mint` and triggers `onERC1155Received` on contract recipients. A contract-based V1 holder can reenter `migrate()` from its callback. The current code is not exploitable for double-mint because V1 burn precedes the V2 mint loop and cached `balance` is not re-read — but this depends on a subtle code ordering. No `ReentrancyGuard` is applied. Event emissions also become inconsistent under reentrancy.
impact: Defense-in-depth concern; not currently exploitable for double-mint but relies on subtle code ordering. Event emissions may become inconsistent under reentrancy.
attack_path: Current ordering prevents double-mint but event/state ordering is fragile.
